claims.text: The declared PaymentService interface exposes Charge, whose request combines Money and CreditCardInfo, and whose response supplies a transaction_id.
This interface describes message shape, but it alone does not prove that any request succeeded.
The charge call sends amount and credit-card information to PaymentService.Charge, where RPC errors return to the caller and successful replies expose a transaction identifier.
